tests.title: valid minimal Markdown prompt passes
tests.preconditions: Clean synthetic governed workspace and absent audit root.
tests.input: Minimal prompt containing all required registered shared values.
tests.observable_action: Create the diagnostics-local source capture and invoke the public CLI with its diagnostics-relative source and absent audit-root paths.
tests.expected_filesystem_effect: Exactly four valid audit files published.

tests.title: complex author-owned Markdown is preserved exactly
tests.preconditions: Valid registered authority.
tests.input: Preamble and prose with whitespace, nested headings, comments, backtick and tilde fences.
tests.observable_action: Compare diagnostics-local source-capture author spans with immediate canonical stdout and authored audit copy.
tests.expected_filesystem_effect: Author spans and authored_prompt.md match byte-for-byte; authored_prompt.md equals the source-capture bytes.

tests.title: unknown shared section blocks
tests.preconditions: Otherwise valid prompt.
tests.input: A top-level section named Unregistered authority containing exactly one top-level fenced text mapping with allowed_to_modify.meta_repo set to arbitrary/path.
tests.observable_action: Invoke the public CLI with the diagnostics-local source capture.
tests.expected_filesystem_effect: No audit output root is published; the source capture remains observational.

tests.title: unknown shared semantic key blocks
tests.preconditions: Known shared section.
tests.input: One unregistered semantic path in its mapping.
tests.expected_filesystem_effect: No published audit root.

tests.title: missing required shared key blocks
tests.preconditions: Otherwise valid prompt.
tests.input: Omit one required registered semantic path.
tests.expected_filesystem_effect: No published audit root.

tests.title: stale root baseline blocks
tests.preconditions: Root synthetic repository has known live HEAD.
tests.input: Different full expected root HEAD.
tests.expected_filesystem_effect: No successful canonical audit publication.

tests.title: stale nested baseline blocks
tests.preconditions: Nested synthetic repository has known live HEAD.
tests.input: Different full expected nested HEAD.
tests.expected_filesystem_effect: No successful canonical audit publication.

tests.title: branch-policy contradiction blocks
tests.preconditions: Live branch is fixed.
tests.input: Registered branch policy with a tuple violating its cross-field constraint.
tests.expected_filesystem_effect: No successful canonical audit publication.

tests.title: live current branch is generated not author-required
tests.preconditions: Valid synthetic repositories.
tests.input: Valid prompt with no current branch or current HEAD author keys.
tests.observable_action: Invoke CLI and inspect immediate canonical stdout.
tests.expected_filesystem_effect: Canonical audit copy contains independently observed branches and HEADs.

tests.title: prose cannot broaden allowed modification scope
tests.preconditions: Structured scope authorizes one file.
tests.input: Author prose says every file may be edited.
tests.observable_action: Invoke CLI and inspect effective authority.
tests.expected_exit_or_state: exit 0 or optional contradiction block, never broader authority
tests.expected_filesystem_effect: Audit records structured one-file scope only.
tests.expected_repository_effect: No mutation; later scope remains one file.

tests.title: structured scope cannot exceed project governance
tests.preconditions: Live governance permits a narrow subtree.
tests.input: Registered scope requests a broader subtree.
tests.expected_filesystem_effect: No successful canonical audit publication.

tests.title: prompt-contract validator error blocks
tests.preconditions: Registry-valid prompt that violates installed prompt-contract output rules.
tests.input: Prompt producing a canonical validator error.
tests.expected_filesystem_effect: No ready audit publication.

tests.title: governance change requires rerun
tests.preconditions: A prior completed invocation and its audit artifacts exist; governance is then changed before a separate new invocation.
tests.input: The same authored prompt in a newly created diagnostics-local source capture.
tests.observable_action: Invoke preflight again after the governance change.
tests.expected_exit_or_state: The new invocation uses the new governance; prior audit artifacts cannot satisfy or replace it.
tests.expected_filesystem_effect: A new absent audit root is required; prior artifacts remain nonauthoritative.

tests.title: repository HEAD change requires rerun
tests.preconditions: A prior completed invocation and its audit artifacts exist; a governed repository HEAD is then advanced before a separate new invocation.
tests.input: The same authored prompt in a newly created diagnostics-local source capture.
tests.observable_action: Invoke preflight again after the HEAD change.
tests.expected_exit_or_state: The new invocation observes the new HEAD and validates the declared baseline against it; prior audit artifacts cannot satisfy or replace it.
tests.expected_filesystem_effect: A new absent audit root is required; prior artifacts remain observational.
tests.expected_repository_effect: The new invocation performs no additional repository mutation.

tests.title: stale diagnostic artifacts never authorize
tests.preconditions: Place a complete old four-file audit directory.
tests.input: No current preflight invocation.
tests.expected_filesystem_effect: Old files may remain unchanged.

tests.title: forged ready-state file never authorizes
tests.preconditions: Place arbitrary ready-looking JSON or legacy readiness package.
tests.input: No current preflight invocation.
tests.expected_filesystem_effect: Forged files are ignored as authority.

tests.title: interrupted or resumed session reruns preflight
tests.preconditions: Interrupt after or during a prior run.
tests.input: Resume or start a new session with the same prompt.
tests.expected_filesystem_effect: Partial or old artifacts do not authorize and are not resumed.

tests.title: absolute source path outside diagnostics blocks
tests.preconditions: An outside regular source file exists.
tests.input: Supply its absolute path where a diagnostics-relative source path is required.
tests.expected_exit_or_state: exit 2 before reading the outside file
tests.expected_filesystem_effect: The outside file is not read and no audit output is published.

tests.title: source symlink blocks
tests.preconditions: A diagnostics-relative source path contains a symlinked parent or final component targeting outside diagnostics.
tests.input: Supply that relative path.
tests.expected_filesystem_effect: The symlink target is not read and no audit output is published.

tests.title: existing output destination blocks
tests.preconditions: Valid diagnostics-local source capture and absent final audit destination at invocation start.
tests.input: Create a destination object at the final name immediately before publication.
tests.observable_action: Allow the CLI to attempt Linux renameat2 with RENAME_NOREPLACE.
tests.expected_filesystem_effect: The destination remains unchanged; staging is not installed, replaced, merged, deleted, or resumed.

tests.title: normal audit publication succeeds
tests.preconditions: Valid prompt and absent contained output root.
tests.input: Valid diagnostics-local source capture and absent audit output root.
tests.observable_action: Invoke CLI then reopen public artifacts.
tests.expected_filesystem_effect: Exactly four schema-valid files; canonical_prompt.md equals stdout and authored_prompt.md equals the source-capture bytes.

tests.title: no task-specific repository action occurs before pass
tests.preconditions: Instrument repository mutations in a failing run.
tests.input: Prompt blocked by registry or baseline.
tests.observable_action: Invoke CLI and inspect repository tree, index, refs, and HEAD.
tests.expected_filesystem_effect: Only nonauthoritative failed-run staging may exist.
tests.expected_repository_effect: Tree, index, refs, branch, and HEAD unchanged.

tests.title: no wrapper or second Codex session is required
tests.preconditions: Fresh normal Codex session with live AGENTS trigger and installed project runtime.
tests.input: Valid prompt manually pasted once by the user.
tests.observable_action: Observe automatic AGENTS invocation, diagnostics-local source capture, and process topology.
tests.expected_exit_or_state: exit 0 in the original session without a user-facing wrapper or second session
tests.expected_filesystem_effect: One exclusive source capture and the declared audit output; no environment handoff or nested-session artifact.

tests.title: no prompt-authored code is executed
tests.preconditions: Subprocess/import/eval/exec/task callbacks instrumented.
tests.input: Prompt contains fenced code and command-looking strings.
tests.expected_exit_or_state: normal validation result without prompt-derived execution
tests.expected_filesystem_effect: Only declared audit files on success.

tests.title: valid prompt continues in the same session
tests.preconditions: Fresh normal Codex session automatically invoked preflight from a valid manually pasted prompt.
tests.input: The trusted current session's diagnostics-local source capture.
tests.observable_action: Capture exit 0 and canonical stdout, then immediately enter a no-op next task phase in the same uninterrupted turn.
tests.expected_exit_or_state: Immediate same-session continuation uses canonical stdout with no freshness harness or persistent token.
tests.expected_filesystem_effect: Source capture plus four observational audit files.
tests.expected_repository_effect: Only the explicit no-op phase; no preflight mutation.

tests.title: duplicate shared semantic path blocks
tests.preconditions: Known shared section and key.
tests.input: Repeat a semantic path, once with identical and once with conflicting values.
tests.expected_filesystem_effect: No successful audit publication.

tests.title: inaccessible transport-identity requirement blocks
tests.preconditions: Otherwise valid prompt.
tests.input: Require identity with hidden chat transport bytes, both alone and beside a safe disclaimer.
tests.expected_exit_or_state: exit 3 for every requirement case; safe disclaimer alone may pass
tests.expected_filesystem_effect: No successful canonical publication for blocked cases.

tests.title: audit publication failure blocks immediate readiness
tests.preconditions: Valid prompt with injected write, reopen, fsync, or atomic-publication failure.
tests.input: Valid diagnostics-local source capture and absent audit output root.
tests.expected_filesystem_effect: No final output root; partial staging remains nonauthoritative.
